content_voiceover: This table is a reference list of approved extended half-life products worth scanning for name recognition rather than memorizing in full. Among the FVIII products, Fc-fusion Elocta has a plasma half-life around nineteen hours, only a one-point-five to one-point-seven fold gain, while PEGylated products like Adynovate and Jivi land in a similar modest range. Among FIX products, the gains are much larger, consistent with the previous slide: Alprolix, an Fc-fusion, reaches eighty-two hours, a four-point-three fold increase, and Idelvion, an albumin-fusion, reaches one hundred one hours, a five-point-three fold increase, with Refixia's glycoPEGylation reaching ninety-three hours. The newest addition, efanesoctocog alfa, branded Altuviiio and approved in 2023, stands out among FVIII products by reaching thirty-seven to forty-one hours, a three to four fold increase, finally closing the gap with FIX products because of its novel VWF-decoupling design.
keypoints: FVIII EHL products (Elocta, Adynovate, Jivi): half-life ~14-19h, 1.3-1.7 fold gain
FIX EHL products (Alprolix, Idelvion, Refixia): half-life 82-101h, 4.3-5.8 fold gain
Efanesoctocog alfa (Altuviiio, 2023): FVIII half-life 37-41h, 3-4 fold gain
Altuviiio breaks the traditional FVIII half-life ceiling via VWF D'D3 fusion
keypoint_voiceover: Traditional FVIII EHL products cluster around fourteen to nineteen hours, while FIX EHL products reach eighty to one hundred hours. Efanesoctocog alfa, brand name Altuviiio, approved in 2023, is the standout FVIII exception at thirty-seven to forty-one hours because of its VWF-decoupling design.
